Description
The 2015 1 oz cook islands $100 gold armillary coin Valcambi is a beautiful and unique coin that is highly sought after by collectors and investors alike. Minted by Valcambi, a world-renowned Swiss refinery, this coin is made from one troy ounce of 99.99% pure gold with a face value of $100 Cook Islands dollars.
The Valcambi armillary
gold coin
design on the coin is based on an ancient astronomical instrument used to model celestial body movements. This instrument was invented by the ancient Greeks and later refined by astronomers during the Renaissance. The Armillary sphere consists of rings representing the circles of the celestial sphere and is designed to show the positions of the sun, moon, and planets.
2015 1 oz Cook Islands Gold Armillary Coin $100 Valcambi is a beautiful and unique coin highly valued by collectors and investors alike. With its stunning design and high purity, this coin is an actual work of art and a valuable addition to any collection.
Design of the 1 oz Cook Island $100 gold Coins
The products that seem like a single flat coin comprise four concentric circles. Each circle contains 1/4 oz of pure gold with a face value of $25. The coin can be twisted into artwork that resembles an armillary sphere or even separated using CombiBar technology into four separate coins.
The obverse side of the 1 oz cook island gold coins features an effigy of Queen Elizabeth II, the head of state of the Cook Islands. The reverse side of the cook island gold coins features the
Armillary design
, surrounded by inscriptions indicating the coin’s weight, purity, and face value.
1 oz Cook Islands Gold Armillary Coin Highlights
Contains 1 ounce of .9999 pure Gold
1/4 separate rings come in a sealed protective assay package.
The assay card lists weight, purity, and authentication by a certified assayer.
Total face value of $100 (Cook Island Dollars).
Individual face value of $25 (CID) per gold coin.
Ships in a special presentation case.
